subject: Stellaris POC — prompt/log handoff & evaluation scope
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@stellaris.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Stellaris POC — prompt/log handoff & evaluation scope

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call today — quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC moving. I kept this intentionally focused so we can hand it to your ops and our ingestion team.

Success criteria (what you emphasized on the call):
- 95th-ile latency < 250ms for interactive flows
- Quality: >85% exact-match on canonical queries; low severity hallucination rate on regulatory prompts
- Cost target for trial steady-state: <$0.015 per 1k tokens (we can show tradeoffs)

Data and artifacts we need from Stellaris to run a representative evaluation:
1) Representative prompt set (JSONL preferred): fields = id, prompt, metadata(optional), expected_answer if available
2) Sample application logs (sanitized): session id, timestamp, user_utterance, system_response, any flags
3) Canonical eval queries (5–10) with pass/fail criteria you care about

Proposed timeline
- Apr 15 — Stellaris shares sanitized sample prompts + one week of logs (or a smaller sample if full export is blocked)
- Apr 16–20 — Redwood ingests data, baseline eval and regression checks
- Apr 21 — Results review call + proposal for canary/controlled trial rollout

Owners (proposed)
- Data upload & schema validation: Elena / Stellaris (procurement@stellaris.ai for ops)
- Ingestion & baseline eval: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com)
- Observability & quality gating: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.com)

Attachments: POC-data-handoff-template.csv (simple CSV template), redwood-prompt-spec.pdf (format guidance).

Can you confirm: 1) you can provide a sanitized sample by EOD Apr 15, or 2) if not, what earlier/later date works? If yes, we’ll schedule a 30-minute intake call on Apr 14 to walk through the template and any redaction constraints.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@stellaris.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellaris.ai
Date: 2026-04-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stellaris POC — prompt/log handoff & evaluation scope

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the clear summary — this aligns with what we discussed. We can provide a sanitized prompt set and a subset of application logs, with a few caveats (see below). Attached are a small sample set and the sysops export for the last 48 hours.

Attachments: stellaris_sample_queries.jsonl (100 lines, see schema), stellaris_sysops_export.txt (sanitized).

Notes and constraints from our side:
- We cannot share raw PII; all user identifiers will be hashed and any free-text PII redacted. We'll include a mapping doc for schema fields so you can match session IDs to timestamps.
- For compliance we need confirmation of retention rules — will Redwood keep the sample for >30 days? We prefer a strict 30-day auto-delete for trial artifacts unless we agree otherwise.
- Procurement asks that we receive a simple SOW and PO instructions before the trial begins. Can you send a trial SOW template to procurement@stellaris.ai?

We aim to deliver the sanitized sample and the exports by EOD Apr 15. If anything blocks that date we'll push to Apr 17 at the latest.

On evaluation metrics — we prioritize:
- Latency (p95)
- Exact-match on canonical queries
- Hallucination/unsafe response rate on regulatory prompts

If you can confirm retention and share the SOW template we’ll be ready.

Best,

Elena Rossi
Head of Product
Stellaris AI
